## Input specifications for selectivity/retention/availability paraemters and functions
Specifying selectivity and retention functions consists of three steps: 

  1. specify parameter values
  2. specify functions and related parameter values

### Parameters 

Parameters are defined independently of the functions to which they might apply.

```{r}
##--set up model dimensions
dim_y = num_to_factor(1948:2025);
dim_s = num_to_factor(1:7);
dim_f = text_to_factor(c("TCF","SCF")); 
dim_x = text_to_factor(c("M","F"));
dim_m = text_to_factor(c("imm","mat"));
dim_c = text_to_factor(c("ns","os"));
dim_zc = seq(25,185,5); #--size cutpoints
dim_zb = calcBinCenters(dim_zc);
dimsYS = tidyr::expand_grid(y=dim_y,s=dim_s);
dimsF  = tidyr::expand_grid(f=dim_f);
dimsPD = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x,m=dim_m,c=dim_c,z=dim_zb);
dimsAll = tidyr::expand_grid(dimsYS,dimsF,dimsPD);
```

```{r}
##--set up various model frames for assigning parameter values and functions
lstMFs = list(); #--list of "model frames"
###--for TCF
####--model frame for fleets: only fleet here is TCF
lstMFs$tblFs_TCF = dimsF |> dplyr::filter(f=="TCF");
####--model frame for year, seasons, and time blocks for TCF selectivity
lstMFs$tblYS_TCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1981:1990,s=3,tb=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                   ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
####--model frames for year, seasons, and time blocks for TCF retention
#####--model frame for z50 in time blocks 1 and 3
lstMFs$tblYS_retZ1 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                      tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                      tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
#####--model frame for z50 in time block 2 (ordinarily would be included above)
lstMFs$tblYS_retZ2 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                       tibble::tibble(y=1981:1990,s=3,tb=2) #--time block 2
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
#####--model frame for widths (note time blocks are different from those for z50)
lstMFs$tblYS_retW1 = dplyr::bind_rows(
                       tibble::tibble(y=1948:1980,s=3,tb1=1), #--time block 1
                       tibble::tibble(y=1991:2025,s=3,tb1=2)  #--time block 2
                     ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb1=factor(tb1));
cap = "Head of tblYS_TCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to TCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
rm(cap);

###--for SCF
lstMFs$tblFs_SCF = dimsF |> dplyr::filter(f=="SCF");
lstMFs$tblYS_SCF = dplyr::bind_rows(
                    tibble::tibble(y=1948:1990,s=3,tb=1), #--time block 1
                    tibble::tibble(y=1991:1996,s=3,tb=2), #--time block 2
                    tibble::tibble(y=1996:2025,s=3,tb=3)  #--time block 3
                   ) |> dplyr::mutate(tb=factor(tb));
cap = "Head of tblYS_SCF, a model frame describing time blocks related to SCF."
kableExtra::kbl(lstMFs$tblYS_TCF |> head(),booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
rm(cap);

###--for population
lstMFs$tblPDs_x      = tidyr::expand_grid(x=dim_x);              #--sex only
lstMFs$tblPDs_male   = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="M"); #--males only
lstMFs$tblPDs_female = lstMFs$tblPDs_x |> dplyr::filter(x=="F"); #--females only
```

```{r}
##--create table linking model frames with fixed effects, environmental covariates, and random effects for selectivity/retention parameters
str = paste0("
 pid   param    MF                                     model     contrasts  label
  1    z50     [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_x]       ~0+x:f:tb  NA         TCF_sel_z50
  2    width   [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+x:f:tb  NA         TCF_sel_width_males
  3    width   [tblYS_TCF;..tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA         TCF_sel_width_females
  4    ascW    [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA         sel_ascending_width_SCF_males
  5    mode    [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA         sel_mode_width_SCF_males
  6    dscW    [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA         sel_descending_width_SCF_males
  7    z50     [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA         sel_z50_SCF_females
  8    width   [tblYS_SCF;..tblFs_SCF;tblPDs_female]  ~0+f:tb    NA         sel_width_SCF_females
  9    z50     [tblYS_retZ1;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA         ret_z50_TCF_males
 10    width   [tblYS_retW1;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb1   NA         ret_width_TCF_males
 11    z50     [tblYS_retZ2;tblFs_TCF;tblPDs_male]    ~0+f:tb    NA         ret_z50_TCF_males
")
tblSelPars = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE);
cap = "tblSelPars, a tibble describing selectivity/retention/availability parameters."
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelPars,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
rm(cap,str);
```

```{r}
#--expand the parameters by the model frames
tblMFs = expandSelParamsMFs(tblSelPars,lstMFs);
lstExpMFs = list();
for (r in 1:nrow(tblMFs)){
  #--testing r = 1;
  cat("expanding row",r,"\n");
  rw = tblMFs[r,];
  mdl = as.formula(rw$model[1]);
  ##--fixed effects
  lstFEs = list();
  if (hasFEs(mdl)){
    fFEs = getFEs(mdl);
    mfFEs = model.frame(fFEs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    if (is.na(rw$contrasts)){
      mmFEs = gmacs.model.matrix(fFEs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    } else {
      mmFEs = stats::model.matrix(fFEs,rw$mf[1][[1]],contrasts.arg=parse(text=rw$contrasts));
    }
    #--drop columns involving missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmFEs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmFEs = mmFEs[,idxs,drop=FALSE];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmmFEs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfFEs,mmFEs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmmFEs = dplyr::distinct(mfmmFEs);
    #--create table
    lstFEs = list(fFEs=fFEs,mfFEs=mfFEs,mmFEs=mmFEs,umfmmFEs=umfmmFEs,
                  mfmmFEs=rw$mf[1][[1]] |> dplyr::inner_join(mfmmFEs));
    rm(fFEs,mfFEs,mfmmFEs,umfmmFEs);
  }
  ##--smooths
  lstSMs = list();
  if (hasSMs(mdl)){
    fSMs = getSMs(mdl);
    mfSMs = model.frame(fSMs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    mmSMs = gmacs.model.matrix(fSMs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    #--drop missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmSMs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmSMs = mmSMs[,idxs];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmmSMs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfSMs,mmSMs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmmSMs = dplyr::distinct(mfmmSMs);
    #--create table
    lstSMs = list(fSMs=fSMs,mfSMs=mfSMs,mmSMs=mmSMs,umfmmSMs=umfmmSMs,
                  mfmmSMs=rw$mf[1][[1]] |> dplyr::inner_join(mfmmSMs));
    rm(fSMs,mfSMs,mfmmSMs,umfmmSMs);
  }
  ##--random effects
  lstREs = list();
  if (hasREs(mdl)){
    fREs = getREs(mdl);
    mfREs = model.frame(fREs,rw$mf[1][[1]]);  #--model frame
    mmREs = gmacs.model.matrix(fREs,rw$mf[1][[1]]); #--model matrix, but may be "expanded" for missing factors levels
    #--drop missing factor levels
    idxs = which(colSums(abs(mmREs))>0);
    if (length(idxs)>0) mmREs = mmREs[,idxs];
    #--combine model frame and model matrix
    mfmmREs = dplyr::bind_cols(mfREs,mmREs);
    #--identify distinct combinations
    umfmmREs = dplyr::distinct(mfmmREs);
    #--create table
    lstREs = list(fREs=fREs,mfREs=mfREs,mmREs=mmREs,umfmmREs=umfmmREs,
                  mfmmREs=rw$mf[1][[1]] |> dplyr::inner_join(mfmmREs));
    rm(idxs,fREs,mfREs,mfmmREs,umfmmREs);
  }
  lstExpMFs[[r]] = tibble::tibble(lstFEs=list(lstFEs=lstFEs),lstSMs=list(lstSMs=lstSMs),lstREs=list(lstREs=lstREs));
  rm(lstFEs,lstSMs,lstREs);
}
##--create tibble with expanded model frames for each parameter
tblExpMFs = dplyr::bind_rows(lstExpMFs);
##--create tibble with expansion info for each parameter by appending `tblExpMFs` columnwise to `tblSelPars`
tblExpSelPars = dplyr::bind_cols(tblSelPars,tblExpMFs);
for (r in 1:nrow(tblExpSelPars)){
  cap = paste0("Unique model matrix rows")
}
#--NOTE: can't just kableExtra::kbl(tblExpSelPars) to see correct structure
#rm(cap,r,lstExpMFs,tblExpMFs,tblSelPars);
```

## Selectivity/retention/availability functions

Selectivity/retention/availability functions are implicitly functions of crab size, *z*, and explicitly functions of parameters through `pids`.

```{r}
##--selectivity/retention/availability function definitions
str = paste0("
fid  function      type  pids        label
1   sel_logistic    sel  [1;2]       TCF_male_selectivity
2   sel_logistic    sel  [1;3]       TCF_female_selectivity
3   sel_dbl_normal3 sel  [4;5;6]     SCF_male_selectivity
4   sel_logistic    sel  [7;8]       SCF_female_selectivity
5   sel_logistic    ret  [9;10]      TCF_male_retention_(start-1980;1991-2025)
6   sel_logistic    ret  [11;10]     TCF_male_retention_(1981-1990)
")
tblSelFcns = readr::read_csv(str |> whitespace_groups_to_commas(),progress=FALSE,show_col_types=FALSE)
cap = paste0("tblSelFcns, a `tibble` describing the types of selectivity and retention functions used in the model. ",
             "Availability is assumed to be 1 for all crab.");
kableExtra::kbl(tblSelFcns,booktabs=TRUE,longtable=TRUE,caption=cap);
```

### Evaluation 

```{r}
tblSPIs = tblSelParInits |> dplyr::select(!pidx);
lstSelFcnsVals = list();
for (fid_ in 1:nrow(tblSelFcns)){
  #--testing: fid_ = 1;
  rw = tblSelFcns[fid_,];
  fid = rw$fid;
  pids = parseBlocks(rw$pids);
  npid = length(pids);

  tblPars = tblSPIs |> dplyr::filter(pid %in% pids) |> 
              dplyr::mutate(pid=factor(paste0("param",pid),levels=paste0("param",pids))) |>
              dplyr::arrange(pid) |>
              tidyr::pivot_wider(names_from="pid",values_from="init",names_sort=FALSE) |>
              remove_aLL_NA_columns(); 
  if (nrow(tblPars |> tidyr::drop_na())==0){
    #--parameters don't share same model frame variables
    tblPars = combine_disjoint_parameter_values(tblPars,npid);
  }
  tblPars = tblPars |> tidyr::drop_na();
  nc = ncol(tblPars);
  tblPars = tblPars |> dplyr::rowwise() |> dplyr::mutate(par_vals=list(vals=dplyr::c_across((nc-npid+1):nc))) |>
              dplyr::select(!tidyselect::starts_with("param"));
  tblSelFcnVals = dplyr::bind_cols(rw,tblPars);
  lstSelFcnsVals[[paste0(fid)]] = tblSelFcnVals;
  rm(fid_,rw,fid,pids,npid,tblPars,nc,tblSelFcnVals);
} #--loop over fid
```
